MODEL & PROVIDER
  model:           "golden-model"
  provider type:   "openai"
  base_url:        "https://api.example.com/v1"
  request_timeout: default (120s)
  retry:           3 attempts (default), 1s initial backoff (default)
  prompt cache:    automatic on this wire (reported in the session log when the endpoint says so)
  max_output_tokens: 4096
  provider mapping (the wire fields this config will send):
    max_output_tokens: 4096 -> max_completion_tokens: 4096
  fallback 1:      "claude-opus-5" via anthropic (default: api.anthropic.com)
  fallback 2:      "deepseek-v4" via openai/deepseek "https://api.deepseek.com/v1"

TOOLS
  workspace: "<TMP>"
  fs builtins (fs_read, fs_write, fs_list): disabled

  subprocess tools: (none)

    PRIMARY_KEY     ✓ set
    FALLBACK_KEY    ✗ MISSING
    BACKUP_KEY      ✗ MISSING

PERMISSIONS
  default policy: allow (unset)

  note: without a TTY, every "ask" policy is auto-denied (headless fail-safe).

BUDGETS
  max_turns:  10

  max_tool_result_bytes: built-in per-tool caps (fs_read 256 KiB, fs_list/subprocess/shell 64 KiB per stream, mcp 64 KiB)
